diagnosis: Record-lineage checkpoint placement has a stable three-regime performance boundary. Per-query capture avoids checkpoint construction for isolated queries; policy checkpoints amortize identity work when a small set of policies is reused; a snapshot checkpoint wins when many policies and queries share one data snapshot.
decision: Admit this query family to grouped cost-model development. Do not use these development scenarios as an independent optimizer holdout.
retained_value: The result supplies a structurally distinct optimizer motivation tied directly to Lineage V4 work: hash rows, evidence edges, checkpoint bytes, policy diversity and reuse count.
scientific_boundary: This admission result establishes candidate diversity and stable reversals, not optimizer generalization. A frozen model and untouched holdout are still required before claiming automatic selection.
